popover.description: Minimal permissions for the S13 popover window. Scoped to that one window, granting the event channel it needs to receive UiSnapshot pushes plus ONE narrow window permission (S13.3): allow-start-dragging, which is what lets `data-tauri-drag-region` on the header move the frameless window. It has no read/write surface of its own — it only relays an already-pressed mouse button into the OS's native move loop — so it does not widen what an XSS in a page rendering unauthenticated agent names could reach for (WINDOW_UI_PLAN.md W-D11 layer 3). Every OTHER window permission (resize, close, minimize, always-on-top, position/size getters and setters, …), plus filesystem, shell and every other core plugin, are deliberately absent. Hiding and quitting go through the app's own ui_close_window / ui_quit commands instead of core:window permissions.
